★
Achievement unlockedVersion 1.0.0

Marvel Champions is now a game you play together. Host a room, share a 6-character code, and your friends play their own heroes from their own phones, tablets and computers, with a lobby, chat and their own decks. Or send a link and let anyone watch your game live. Trickster Takeover's Epic Multiplayer puts several tables against one Loki, and Civil War Competitive pits two teams against each other, leader against leader. This is version 1.0.0: every released Marvel Champions product, playable alone or online.

4

watch a live game, co-op rooms, Epic Multiplayer and Civil War Competitive.

for playing together, Epic, Competitive, watching and hosting.

1–4

each on their own device, with their own hero and deck.

Brand new, so tell us what breaks

Online play is the biggest thing we've ever shipped, and it is very new. You will likely find bugs. When you do, report them from Pause ▸ Report a problem, a GitHub issue or the community Discord, and say it was an online room (the Bug report form now asks). We'll work through them quickly. Single player and offline play are untouched: nothing online starts until you choose Play online.

Play together

Issue #881 · PR #904
★
Achievement unlockedAvengers, Assemble!

Every player plays their own hero, on their own device. The host's device runs the game, and every move a guest makes is checked by the host's rules engine against the table that guest saw, so everyone stays on the same game.

At the table

  • A whose-turn line in the top bar says who is acting, and your board unlocks when it is your turn.
  • Ask the host to undo, or ask for a change, from your board. The host accepts or declines, and Strict rooms have no Undo at all.
  • A player who drops out can be taken over or handed to someone else, or the table can wait for them.
  • In-game chat, with an unread badge and a sound when it arrives while you're away.
  • Hands stay hidden from the other players. Show my hand shows yours to the table, and the host can open every hand for a teaching game.
  • The host picks who paces the villain phase: the host leads, or each player goes at their own pace.
  • Reload, and you're back in your room and game. If the host closes the room mid-game, a guest keeps the game as a single-player save.

Rooms and the lobby

Issue #880 · PR #901
★
Achievement unlockedNick Fury Calls the Team

Play online is on the Title. Set your online name, host a room and share its 6-character code or link, or join a friend's. The host sets up the table, everyone takes a seat and picks a deck, and the game starts when every seat is ready.

Your deck, checked

Each player picks their own hero and deck, custom and Mod Store decks included, from a grid of hero tiles. Build a new deck or import one from MarvelCDB without leaving the room. The host can preset a deck for a seat, and checks every deck at Start, telling only that player why theirs was turned down.

The host's room

Choose Standard, Epic or Competitive from three comic box-art tiles. Pick Strict or Host control play, who may Undo (Off, Host only or Ask the host), house rules, allowed mods and whether cheats are on. List the room in Live now so others can find it (off by default). Everyone sees each person's device in the lobby.

Watch live

Issue #876 · PR #878
★
Achievement unlockedThe Watcher Is Watching

Let anyone watch your game from a link. Turn it on for a game in setup, or always in Settings, then share the link from the eye on the board's top bar or from Pause. Watchers follow every move in the replay viewer, with a LIVE marker, and hands stay hidden from them.

On Discord: while your game is open to watchers, your Discord card shows a Watch live button and how many people are watching.

Epic Multiplayer: many tables, one Loki

Issue #882 · PR #905
★
Achievement unlockedGlorious Purpose

Trickster Takeover, the way it was meant to be played. Several tables of one to four players, each with its own host, take on one shared Loki, God of Lies and one Worlds Collide, through a pod that keeps every table in step.

  • The flip, the stop rule, and the win and loss for every table, by the rules.
  • Real attacks and thwarts on another table's Mangog and Door Between Worlds.
  • Watchers switch between tables from the Tables sheet.

Civil War Competitive: pick a side

Issue #883 · PR #923
★
Achievement unlockedWhose Side Are You On?

Registration against Resistance, in an online room. Pick a side for each seat (1v1 or 2v2), seal a scenario for the other team, ready up, and play with both areas on the board, leader against leader.

Every leader card plays

Every Synthezoid Smackdown leader player card is scripted, from She-Hulk's and Vision's to Calculated Risk and Synthezoid Strike, with two-team tests for the Standard PvP cards and the pool cards that fire on the other team's turn. Choosing Sides shows the leader cards a team earns.

Friendly play, for now

The host's device sees the whole game, and the lobby says so. Hiding each team's hand from the other is next (#924). Competitive games count as played only: no unlocks, achievements or win rates.

Multiplayer achievements

Issue #909 · PR #954
★
Achievement unlockedEarth's Mightiest Teammates

49 new achievements. For playing together, Epic Multiplayer, Civil War Competitive, watching and hosting, plus table feats from @bluefireF5ran's list and a first-win-with-friends bonus by table size.

Fair points: each device keeps its own result of a room game, a host's room games count only for the seats they played, and a room with Cheats on or an adjusted game earns no points, achievements or stats.

The road to 1.0

Everything you can play in v1.0.0
  • Every released product, from the Core Set through Shadowland: 64 packs, 69 heroes, 68 scenarios and 331 encounter sets, each card scripted against its printed text and errata.
  • All eleven campaigns, with expert rules, story beats and each box's between-game choices.
  • The Mod Store: reviewed community heroes, villains, scenarios, campaigns and house rules.
  • Decks: precons, the deck builder and MarvelCDB import, checked against the deckbuilding rules.
  • Replays and Past games, Your stats, the Trophy Room, Extras and Guided mode.
  • Your saves on every device, with no login.
  • Everywhere: the browser, Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iPhone and iPad, in English and Spanish.
  • And now online, with everything above.

Also in v1.0.0

PRs #1010 and this report
  • The Title on a tablet or desktop shows Play online as a comic splash panel with the live-rooms count, and Play online is a split screen with your recent rooms to rejoin.
  • The Bug report form asks whether you were playing single player or in an online room, and the in-game report says it for you.
  • The README has iPhone and iPad download buttons and a Mods section, and the docs describe online play.
  • In The Once and Future Kang's separate game areas, triggered abilities and Team-Up hear only their own area.
  • The landing page's multiplayer section says Out now, and the release keeps its version 1.0.0.
  • This report, in English and Spanish.
